about: The Mistral model router's table: a copy of the PrompTugal Swarm's tools/llm-models.json (Apache-2.0, https://github.com/PrompTugal/PrompTugal__News__Swarm), with every tier on Mistral's own API. The caller names a tier, never a model, unless it must. Model ids from GET https://api.mistral.ai/v1/models on 20 November 2026. Prices in USD per million tokens (input/output), as read on 20 November 2026 at the source below.

cheap.for: classify, extract, summarise, check, first drafts

cheap8.for: translation and short structured work a little above the 3B

hard.for: reviews and checks; magistral-small-latest has no published price and its card says deprecated, so it is not used

note: cap_usd is the whole night's cap for this agent, counted from every line of the ledger (the team rule is 3 USD; 2.5 leaves a margin). Cost is computed from prices_usd_per_m and the usage tokens Mistral returns; Mistral's own invoice is the authority.
